note: Real measurements from design-plan.md Phase 6 (load test & tuning), run on a single Windows development laptop - NOT the design plan's 2 vCPU/4GB VPS target. See docs/benchmark.md in the repo for full methodology, tables, and honest gaps vs. the design targets. Numbers here are recorded, not live.

machine.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS, 8 cores / 16 threads, 3.1 GHz base
machine.docker: Docker Desktop, engine 29.6.1, WSL2 backend, 16 CPUs / ~11.6 GiB allotted
machine.note: Not the 2 vCPU/4GB VPS the design plan's targets assume - see docs/benchmark.md for what would likely differ on that hardware.

ingest_events_per_s.note: sustained with flat latency; unbounded queueing observed by 60,000 events/s

concurrent_ws_clients_per_gateway.note: established before handshakes started timing out; 20,000 sustained cleanly at 100% established

e2e_latency_p50_ms.note: met at light load, grows with client/rate scale

e2e_latency_p99_ms.note: not met at any tested client count >= 10,000

recovery_after_ws_drop_s.note: reconnect + resumed event flow, measured from container restart; see gaps for an auto-restart caveat

s1_ingest_ceiling.description: Single processor instance, synthetic loadgen-producer load, real Polymarket traffic also flowing throughout.

s2_fanout_ceiling.description: In-network client (container-to-container, bypassing this Windows machine's host port-forwarding, which was a lower, separate bottleneck at just 1,000-5,000 connections - see docs/benchmark.md).

s5_chaos_recovery.description: docker kill -SIGKILL, recovery measured from manual restart (docker-compose's restart:unless-stopped did not auto-fire on this Docker Desktop/Windows setup - see docs/benchmark.md).

s6_horizontal_scale.description: Same 20,000 total clients, one gateway instance vs. split across two.

flush_interval_ms.note: floored to 1ms (0 crashes without a guard, fixed this phase)

optimizations.json_vs_binary: skipped - explicitly optional per design-plan.md section 5

pprof_headline_findings: Idle heap: ~68% of sampled heap traced to retained Kafka fetch/decompress buffers, pinned alive by the gateway's tick cache storing kgo Record byte slices without copying them (internal/hub/cache.go). Fix recommended, not applied this phase.

CPU under 20,000-client load: 60% of CPU time is raw write(2) syscalls fanning out to individual client sockets, not JSON encoding or locking - confirms the pre-encoding/conflation design is working as intended.
known_gaps: processor_consume_lag metric under-reports real lag under overload (overwrites instead of accumulating per-partition)
gateway_slow_client_evictions_total does not increment for every slow-client disconnect path
restart: unless-stopped did not auto-restart killed containers on this Docker Desktop/Windows setup - needs re-verification on the real target VPS
S3 (hot market) and naive-remarshal comparisons were only run at moderate scale, not re-validated at 20,000+ clients
JSON vs. binary encoding comparison skipped (optional stretch item)
